description:
Remotely open player inventories with server privilege.

  Open Inventory:

This is a mod for remotely accessing and modifying player inventories.

Use /open to open inventories and access them.
Use /close to close inventories and sync data.
Use /openinv to see which player inventories are currently open.
Use /viewers to see which players are currently looking at inventories.

All chat commands require the 'server' priv. (The same required for /clearinv.)
Only two inventories can be opened at once, indexed by 1 and 2.
More information can be obtained with /help inside the game.

Players who have their inventories opened cannot move or drop items within
their inventory. However, they can pick up items, and get items from digging.
Discrepencies between the original opened inventory and the current will be
added to the new inventory when synced, or dropped (if there is no space).

On the inventories screen, opened inventories appear on the bottom
left, and your own inventory appears on the bottom right.
Crafting menus are positioned on top.

If there are no viewers left, all inventories are automatically closed.
